meta.title: Row Filters and Column Masks: Functions First, Then Attach

views.label: Export the policy set
views.note: Row filters, column masks, and ABAC policies are exported before anything is written against the target.

views.label: Functions, then attachment
views.note: The filter and mask are UDFs and must be redeployed — attaching without redeploying the function attaches nothing.

views.label: Prefer ABAC in bulk
views.note: Hand-attaching to hundreds of tables is exactly the step that silently drops coverage.

cards.title: Same discipline as grants
items: Extract the full source policy set before writing anything against the target
Row filters and column masks are SQL functions registered in Unity Catalog, then attached
ABAC policies key off tags instead of per-table attachment

cards.title: Functions are redeployed, not referenced
items: A row filter or column mask is a UDF — it must be recreated in the target catalog, not just re-pointed
Confirm tags were actually migrated before assuming an ABAC policy will attach correctly
Attach, then query as a representative non-privileged principal and diff against source behavior

cards.title: ABAC is the bulk-migration default
items: Hand-attaching filters/masks to hundreds of tables is exactly the step that silently drops coverage
A tag-driven ABAC policy covers new tables automatically, present or future
Prefer it whenever the source pattern was already consistent, e.g. 'any table tagged pii'
